videos.title: I Tested This FREE Claude Design Alternative (It's Good!)
videos.summary: Build Open Design, a free open-source alternative to Claude Design, from source on Linux and use it with DeepSeek V4 Flash. A 20-second paper cutout motion video takes about a minute for roughly a cent, and a slide deck built from a YouTube transcript takes three to four minutes for about 16 cents and exports to HTML. Mac and Windows have downloads, while Linux needs a source build with Node and corepack fixes.
videos.heading: Open Design with DeepSeek V4 Flash: motion video and slides
